_note: P12 초상화 5 + 스킬 아이콘 9 (오너 지시 2026-08-18 「캐릭터 초상화랑 스킬 아이콘도 바꿔야지」). 모델은 nano_banana_flash(진짜 나노바나나 2). 초상화 정체성은 P9와 같은 문단을 재사용 — 본체 스프라이트와 얼굴이 어긋나면 초상화가 거짓말이 된다.

rulesets.p_tank: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions with a large pale mask-like head and small body, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. The character is a rotund moss-covered beetle knight ('철갑의 용사'): dark green-grey carapace overgrown with moss, an ENORMOUS round shield as big as its whole body, two curved dark horns, a small skull-white mask face with hollow dark eyes, wielding a long-hafted battle axe. Heavy, immovable presence. A CHARACTER PORTRAIT: bust framing from chest up, three-quarter angle, looking slightly toward the viewer, calm expression, dark atmospheric vignette background in deep blue-grey tones. Square 1:1 composition filling the frame. No text, no border.
